# `duty`

Role-based operational workflows: on-call incident logging/querying and structured engineering interview preparation, execution, and debriefing.

## Prerequisites

- The [GitHub Copilot CLI](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli) (or Agency) with this marketplace added (see **Install** below).

No other external tools or credentials are required.

## Install

Add the marketplace once, then install this plugin:

```bash
copilot plugin marketplace add Menny1337/copilot-plugins
copilot plugin install duty@copilot-plugins
```

Update later with `copilot plugin update duty@copilot-plugins` (or `plugins-update` to refresh everything). See the [repository README](../../README.md) for per-session Agency profiles, aliases, and global-install options.
